scope: Two proposed updates for coordinator merge by ID; no modification of App-owner assessments.

requirements.before: Verification UI had no supported Aadhaar provider integration; the original page 26 explicitly suggested Sandbox. Existing Trust accepted the legacy approved Aadhaar source only.
requirements.implemented: Supported Sandbox DigiLocker consent/initiate/status/issued-Aadhaar metadata adapter with authenticated account-bound private ledger, disabled default and test non-award; Verification consent/hosted link/status UI; production verified outcome adds existing Aadhaar +20 and preserves selfie/Nitro/other Trust rules.
requirements.acceptanceScope: Local protocol/security/DB/UI verification only. No claim of live identity verification, deployed screenshot, provider activation, or ownership demonstration from a synthetic test.
requirements.reason: Provider flow remains disabled pending authorized Sandbox/DigiLocker entitlement and Requestor onboarding, environment credentials, registered HTTPS redirect, production activation approval and a consenting real-person hosted-flow acceptance. Remote credentials absence was not established. Coordinated deployment and visual acceptance also remain pending.
